description: This Java class 'OpenAPIExpectationSerializer' handles serialization and deserialization of OpenAPIExpectation objects, including validation, logging, and conversion to and from JSON format within the mockserver project.

classes.name: OpenAPIExpectationSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for OpenAPIExpectation objects, providing methods to serialize, deserialize, and validate OpenAPI expectations in JSON format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an OpenAPIExpectation object to JSON string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a list of OpenAPIExpectation objects to JSON string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an array of OpenAPIExpectation objects to JSON string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an OpenAPIExpectation object, with validation.

methods.name: deserializeToExpectations
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a list of Expectations using OpenAPIConverter.

methods.name: supportsType
methods.description: Returns the class type supported by this serializer.

methods.name: deserializeArray
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON array string into an array of OpenAPIExpectation objects.
